description: Use when someone asks what is being built near an address or a place: new buildings next door, construction on the block, what's permitted around a home they might buy or rent. Give a city and street address, or a latitude and longitude. Returns building permits within a radius (default 400 meters, about a quarter mile) issued since a date (default about six months back), newest first, each with distance in meters and compass direction from the point. Covers the last 24 months of city open data. counts.total is exact even when the list is capped.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '2443 W Warren Blvd'.

city.description: City slug, e.g. chicago. Needed with address; optional with lat and lon.

lat.description: Latitude, used instead of city and address.

lon.description: Longitude, used instead of city and address.

since.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD, or 6m, 1y, 2y. Default 6m (the first of the month five months back).

name: permits_near
title: Permits near an address or a point
